description: Official OpenAPI 3.1 snapshot, hosted MCP sign-in guide, and smoke tests for the LeadMagic B2B data API (contact and company enrichment, email finding and validation, profile and job enrichment, intent signals).
rules: Use the documented public API only. Do not infer endpoints or expose private implementation details.
REST uses https://api.leadmagic.io and X-API-Key. Read keys from a secret manager or environment; never put them in public examples.
Hosted MCP uses https://mcp.leadmagic.io/mcp with OAuth. Follow https://leadmagic.io/docs/mcp/setup for current client instructions.
JSON and YAML snapshots must remain equivalent. Examples are synthetic and are not live test fixtures.
Do not claim guaranteed delivery, accuracy, compliance, certification, endorsement, or performance without current evidence and permission to publish it.
Official repository links are listed in README.md. Third-party projects may be independent; a brand mention alone does not establish affiliation.
